firstAha: share of the national total of the measure held by the provinces with the most of it (at most three; never cutting a tie, never every province holding it), with numerator and denominator, the same share among house plots only (detached, semi-detached, row) as a second bar with both bases, and the provinces with no record by name; in a province, the districts with the most of the measure and their share of the province; computed per selection
countingUnit: measure switch: allocated plots (แปลง, default) or records (รายการ); a project carries no figure of its own
noCaveats: exactness through names, numerator and denominator, and one provenance line per view
